title: ashhq-ed1
description: Modlist compiled for Ash Headquarters server.
body:
Ash Headquarters - First Edition is a cozy, creative-focused Minecraft modpack built for friends who want a shared world that feels handcrafted and full of discovery without overwhelming complexity. This collection blends thoughtful tech, lush biomes, and immersive building tools to encourage cooperative play, emergent projects, and relaxed exploration.

Create brings elegant, mechanical automation that rewards ingenuity: gear-driven contraptions, conveyors, and rotational power let players invent everything from scenic moving bridges to efficient resource sorters without breaking immersion. BetterEnd and Biomes O’ Plenty jointly transform the world with breathtaking new landscapes - crystalline forests, violet pillars, candy-colored islands, and expansive continental biomes give your group fresh places to build bases, host meetups, and stage events. Farmers Delight deepens food and farming with new crops, cooking mechanics, and rustic furniture that fit perfectly into communal kitchens and village expansions.

Complementing the core experience are light-touch mods that add polish and options without hijacking gameplay: decorative packs for varied building aesthetics, atmospheric sound and lighting tweaks, QoL utilities like waypoints and inventory improvements, and small adventure mods that introduce optional challenges and treasures. Multiplayer-friendly features make group projects easy - shared crafting areas, plot markers, and gentle balance adjustments to ensure no single mod steals the spotlight.

Ash Headquarters is designed for storytelling and collaboration. Use Create to build a working town square, carve a scenic railway through Biomes O’ Plenty’s taiga, or host a harvest festival with Farmers Delight recipes. The pack keeps progression simple and social: start small, specialize, and combine each player’s strengths into sprawling cooperative creations.
